Definition: a head-dress (i.e. piece of cloth wrapped around)
BiblicalUsage: tsânîyph is the word for a head-dress. It appears 4 times in Scripture, including Isaiah 62:3 and Zechariah 3:5.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave us tsânîyph because the idea it carries belongs in His Word.
